body: The crash now seems to be reproducible consistently when a video is playing in firefox and I select a tile on a tilemap layer in a relatively new project with lots of assets. about 16MB unpacked. I tried to reproduce it in a simple project with just the godot icon did not get that working. the tutorial I was following was [Recreate Stardew Valley in Godot & and master advanced Godot concepts](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jIKuiUdCsuo) with the project around the 1:24:56 mark. Nothing too complex just yet just character movment and setting up tilemaps at this point Main Scene:

Tested Versions:

- Reproducible: v4.6.dev1.official [8d8041bd4]
- Reproducible v4.6.dev2.official [7864ac801]
- Reproducible: v4.6.dev3.official [9d84f3d13]
- Reproducible: v4.6.dev4.official [bd2ca13c6]
- Not Reproducible: v4.6.dev5.official [f5918a9d3]
- Not Reproducible: v4.6.beta2.official [551ce8d47]

I am going to try staying on version v4.6.dev5 to see if I get a crash.

Thanks for testing the dev versions! It's great to hear that 4.6 dev 5 might have fixed things for you. Personally I suggest sticking with 4.6 beta 2 instead of dev 5 since it will be a bit more polished. 

In either case, please let us know if you can reproduce the issue after a few days of testing. If the issue has truly gone away we will close this bug report as fixed.

If you run the Godot engine through the terminal in verbose mode you may be able to see what is causing the crash to occur.

This is the command to run godot in verbose mode:
`godot -v`

I'm seeing this as well on my machine with [4.5-stable](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/tag/4.5-stable) Interestingly, also with the TileMapLayer
